title: Snack vs Crown
why: You ate one snack. I ate the whole queen.

title: Two-Headed Knight
why: One jump bites the king and the rook. The pawn snack hangs your horse.

title: Tiny Double Bite
why: A tiny pawn checks the king and bites the rook at the same time.

title: Poison Lunch
why: Count defenders. The pawn takes back. You lose a queen for a bishop.

title: Thumbtack
why: Line the bishop up. The knight is glued to the king and cannot run.

title: Frozen Lunch
why: The knight is frozen to the king. Take the frozen lunch.

title: Skewer Stick
why: Check the king. He must step aside. The rook behind him dies.

title: Basement Door
why: His own pawns locked the basement. Mate beats a pawn hunt.

title: Leftover Loose
why: The rook on the back door is mate. The knight is only a snack.

title: Their Future First
why: Taking their queen feels huge. Mating them ends the movie.

title: Hidden Laser
why: The knight steps aside. The bishop becomes a laser. The queen explodes.

title: Crowns Not Cookies
why: Two royal heads beat one snack pawn. Fork the king and the rook.
